newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Rogers offers lower final 1996 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Rogers offers lower final 1996 dividend.

text.p: The largest conglomerate in Mauritius, Rogers, on Friday declared a final dividend of 1.20 rupees per share for its financial year ending 30 September 1996, down from 1.30 rupees per share for the previous year.

"A final dividend of 1.20 rupees per share has been declared by the board to all ordinary shareholders registered at the close of business on 9 September 1996, payable in full on 26 September 1996," company secretary Andre Raffray said.
"Shares of Rogers and Company Limited will therefore be quoted ex-dividend at the Stock Exchange sessions of the 11, 13, 16, 18, 20, 23, and 25 September 1996," he added.
With an interim dividend of 1.20 rupees per share declared in March 1996, Rogers' total dividend for the year ended September 1996 amounts to 2.40 rupees per share.
Rogers declared an interim dividend of 1.20 rupees per share in March 1995 and then made a bonus issue of one share for every two held in April 1995.

Rogers forecasts pre-tax profit for the year ended September 30, 1996 similar to the 428.6 million rupees ($21.1 million) in 1995. Rogers' interim pre-tax profit for the six months to 31 March 1996 was up 3.3 percent to 293.8 million rupees as compared with the corresponding period in 1995.
